title: Diaries and finishing RFD
seoTitle: Ironman Diaries & Recipe for Disaster Guide (OSRS Step 1.5)
description: Complete achievement diaries and finish Recipe for Disaster for Barrows gloves - the best-in-slot gloves for most of the game.

steps.text: Do all of the RFD subquests
steps.note: If u didn't fish the 3k karambwans during agility for cook xp, u can leave awowogei's quest until later

steps.text: Buy a bunch of chocolate dust from the chest and make energy pots
Plant some Toadflax seeds, agility potion is needed soon for a quest
steps.note: If you don't have toadflax seed for some reason, you can do brimhaven agility arena and buy toadflax with the vouchers you earn (3 vouchers each)

steps.text: Make a mithril grapple

Do these quests for QP and diaries: A soul's bane, Another slice of H.A.M, Icthlarin's little helper, Contact!, In search of the Myreque, In aid of the Myreque, Eagles' peak, Enakhra's Lament, Rat catchers, Olaf's quest, Between a rock, Tai bwo wannai trio, Zogre flesh eater
steps.note: Contact! (needs Icthlarin's Little Helper + Prince Ali Rescue) is required for Beneath Cursed Sands below. Eagles' Peak is required for At First Light.

steps.text: Complete Perilous Moons quest when you reach 48 Slayer (requires Twilight's Promise done)
steps.note: Gives ~40k Slayer XP reward. Unlocks access to the Blood Moon, Blue Moon, and Eclipse Moon bosses. Blood Moon drops the Blood Moon armour set (melee) which is very strong for mid-game.

steps.text: Complete Defender of Varrock quest (55 Smithing, 52 Hunter + prerequisites)
steps.note: Gives ~35k XP (15k Smithing, 15k Hunter, 5k antique lamp). Also a prerequisite for While Guthix Sleeps, one of the best quests for ironmen. Unlocks the Zombie Axe at 65 Attack.

steps.text: Complete Beneath Cursed Sands when you reach 62 Agility (requires Contact! done)
steps.note: Unlocks the Keris Partisan weapon and access to Tombs of Amascut (ToA). ToA is one of the best sources of gear upgrades for ironmen, providing Osmumten's Fang, Lightbearer, and more.

steps.text: Complete At First Light quest (now that Eagles' Peak is done; also needs 46 Hunter, 30 Herblore, 27 Construction)
steps.note: Moved here because it requires Eagles' Peak (completed in the quest batch above). Unlocks the Hunter Guild and the Rumours hunter training system - the best Hunter training AND a supply engine (loot sacks give herbs, seeds, nests, bones, blessed bone shards). Integrate Rumours alongside birdhouse runs.

steps.text: Rum deal (Req 42 slayer, you should be close to it. Get a task from Mazchna for Mory diary if you don't have one)
steps.note: For the 47 prayer req, you can use the ancient mace spec to boost

steps.text: Cabin fever
One small favour
Watchtower quest
Do all easy and medium diaries
steps.note: Kourend diaries can be left undone, I dont do them until I have Xerics tally from shamans and staminas for the quests. Wildy and fremmy mediums require higher slayer, leave those for when you go back to slayer. You probably don't have a crystal key for fally medium diary yet so leave that for later as well

steps.text: For Lumby 50 range req I'd recommend ranging at pest control with bone cbow
steps.note: If you're not 70cb for intermediate boat then go do slayer now, train attack to 60 then defense until 70cb. May as well stay until you get 250pts for void bottoms, good mage def. Need 55 range eventually anyway for red chins

steps.text: Do Slayer until 60 attack
Buy Dragon scim
steps.note: Normally I have recommended to also buy a Dragon battleaxe, but it's really just not needed anymore due to how easy it is to get kwuarms and limpwurts nowadays with farming contracts

steps.text: Do Eadgar's ruse
Do My arm's big adventure
Do Desert Treasure
steps.note: If you didn't get magic logs from Wintertodt, go catch nature implings in puro-puro, you should have 58 hunter easily by now from birdhouses
steps.updateNote: If you unlocked GOTR earlier, Runecraft no longer needs to be your lowest skill for Tears of Guthix. Redirect ToG to whichever skill you least enjoy training.

steps.text: Finish RFD, buy B gloves
steps.note: Here's a video of me killing the bosses with stats from following this guide, not too difficult
